title: Beach Bike Cottage | KEY.co
description_expanded: This stunning home in the heart of Seacrest Beach is a haven of elegance and comfort, designed for unforgettable gatherings with family and friends. The open-concept living area boasts soaring ten-foot ceilings, pecky cypress beams, and a cozy fireplace, seamlessly flowing into a chef’s kitchen with Thermador appliances, custom cabinetry, and a large marble island. Perfect for entertaining, the home also features a sumptuous dining room, a well-appointed wet bar, and two oversized porches ideal for relaxing or enjoying a good book with a glass of wine. Every detail, from the luxurious finishes to the inviting spaces, is crafted to create a serene and sophisticated coastal escape. Upstairs, spacious guest suites and a charming bunk room lead to the third-floor tower room, a bonus space that opens onto a deck with an outdoor fireplace and breathtaking views. Located in the casual yet character-filled Seacrest Beach community, this home offers easy access to sugar-white sand beaches, tranquil dune lakes, and charming shops and restaurants. With its peaceful ambiance, family-friendly vibe, and stunning natural surroundings, this property delivers an unparalleled 30A experience, perfect for creating cherished memories.

Features: Indoor Fireplace Internet TV Kitchen island
Private balcony Covered patio Roof terrace
